reason: The extension faithfully transports the proved central-leg event data to actual global time. Generic endpoint collars have positive width 1/d.count. For any actual nongeneric global time, the proof chooses a genuine covering fine cell, excludes the Generic first/last coarse cells, derives actual control-root membership from nongenericness, and uses proved endpoint nonvanishing to put its local parameter strictly between 0 and 1. No root, factor name, interior position or derivative premise is supplied by the caller. The proved central patch is rescaled by the actual positive fine-mesh speed d.count*(2*n): its radius is divided by that speed and its curve evaluates the actual leg at r+speed*s. The exact affine local-time identity proves that the germ equals the actual global path at t+s throughout its common positive-radius parameter interval. This transfers Regular membership and vertex injectivity without relabeling any occurrence. Actual nongeneric centre and punctured Generic membership are retained. The selected control changes sign; every other control has positive product with its central value throughout the same interval; the actual time derivative equals the nonzero local parameter slope times the positive mesh speed. The independent raw-source example derives one actual path from continuity, Regular membership, Generic endpoints and delta>0, then obtains the full conclusion at every actual nongeneric time without separate event/transversality hypotheses. All 12 new declarations independently kernel-check with only standard axioms. Ambient hypersurface smoothness and the complete disjoint named-wall dictionary remain unproved and are not certified.

mathematical_justification.assessment: The collar width is epsilon=1/d.count>0. Cell exhaustion and fine-to-coarse containment put every time t in a coarse interval [q/N,(q+1)/N]. If t<1/N, the lower bound implies q<1, so q=0. If t>1-1/N, the upper bound implies N<q+2; together with q<N this forces q+1=N. Actual Generic membership on the first or last coarse cube then applies at every such t, including the fixed endpoints. This uses Generic cube membership, not nonvanishing of every control at the original endpoints. The strict inequalities define actual positive-width relative endpoint neighborhoods.

mathematical_justification.clause: Derived actual central-leg interior and root
mathematical_justification.assessment: For any covering fine cell at a nongeneric time, either endpoint coarse index would contradict actual Generic collar-cell membership. The remaining finite-index inequalities therefore give a genuine central cell. The exact central-branch identity transfers nongenericness to the actual local tuple, and the proved all-control-nonzero implication derives an actual named root. Local time is initially in [0,1]; if it were 0 or 1, the corresponding endpoint-control nonvanishing theorem would contradict that root membership. It is therefore in (0,1). The main aggregate chooses the covering cell itself, so no cell, root, name or interior-time premise is hidden in the source-facing use. Inactive T roots which remain Generic are not selected.

For positive speed a and patch radius rho, s in (-rho/a,rho/a) implies a*s in (-rho,rho) by multiplying the strict inequalities by a>0. The elaborated scaled_parameter_mem theorem retains that positive-speed parameter. The constructed radius is rho/a and is positive. The actual curve is tupleOfScalarCoordinates(leg.assignment W (r+a*s)), continuous by composition with the real affine time map. Its centre equals the actual tuple at r. Nonzero s gives nonzero a*s inside the patch, so the existing punctured Generic theorem applies; the actual event supplies the nongeneric centre. The inherited bounds rho<=r and rho<=1-r then give r+a*s in (0,1) on the entire same germ interval. An independent example checks both the exact divided-radius formula and its positivity.

mathematical_justification.clause: Exact global-time equality on the entire germ
mathematical_justification.assessment: The speed a is the actual fine-cell count N=d.count*(2*n), cast to a positive real. At event time t, r=N*t-k. Local patch bounds give r+N*s in (0,1). With 0<=k and k+1<=N, the helper derives that t+s is in the actual unit interval; its body derives both strict bounds before returning the closed interval membership certificate. For the genuine subtype u with value t+s, ring arithmetic proves uniformMeshLocalTime N k u=r+N*s. The reverse local-time/cell-membership equivalence puts u in the SAME fine cell. Its exact central-branch identity gives g.curve(s)=A.path(u) for every germ parameter. No unrelated local path or arbitrary reparameterization is substituted, and subtype proof certificates do not change tuple values.

mathematical_justification.clause: One changing control and all other signs on one interval
mathematical_justification.assessment: The inherited SignChanges predicate evaluates the actual germ on positive and negative side parameters. For positive s and a>0, r-a*s<r<r+a*s. The proved affine-root product theorem gives a negative product at those actual leg parameters; scalar reconstruction and commutativity give exactly the positive-side/negative-side germ product. The witness is the full divided radius rho/a. For each other control the central patch gives positive product with its central value whenever the parameter is within rho of r. The same scaling inequality applies simultaneously to every other control and every germ parameter, including zero. Thus the actual other controls stay nonzero and retain their central signs on one common interval, without a central Generic premise.

mathematical_justification.clause: Nonzero derivative in actual global time
mathematical_justification.assessment: The affine map s↦r+a*s has derivative a: the inspected pinned constant-multiplication and constant-addition rules give the exact value. The inspected pinned HasDerivAt chain rule multiplies the actual outer control derivative by a, giving parameterSlope*a at zero for the explicit affine extension. The patch has a genuine root; under the same JointLegConditions it forces coordinate dependence, whose evaluated slope and scalar step are proved nonzero. Hence parameterSlope is nonzero and so is its product with a>0. The aggregate states this derivative for the exact actual central-leg expression with the global mesh speed. The full curve equality identifies that expression with the control of the globally timed germ on its neighborhood. This proves one-dimensional transversality along the path; it does not by itself certify an ambient smooth-hypersurface or nonvanishing-gradient theorem.

mathematical_justification.clause: Actual Regular geometry, collision freedom and labels
mathematical_justification.assessment: At every germ parameter the exact t+s equality supplies a genuine global unit-interval time. The already constructed path is Regular at that time, and its globally proved injectivity uses the same common waypoint conditions. Both properties transfer to the germ, including its nongeneric centre. The type remains the same actual LabelledTuple n with fixed occurrence indices and the exact scalar-coordinate branches; no quotient substitution, deletion or relabeling occurs. No extra central Regular, G1 or Generic assumption is imposed.

The independent compiled example assumes only n>=3, an actual continuous labelled-tuple curve, pointwise Regular membership, Generic endpoints and delta>0. It derives NeZero internally, the actual cube subdivision and one common W and approximation A. It then returns exact labelled endpoints and positive Generic collars, and for EVERY actual nongeneric time returns the full aggregate: actual cell label, derived central index, name and genuine WallGerm, centre equality, exact t+s curve equality, Regular/injective geometry, sign change, all other positive products and nonzero HasDerivAt at the actual global speed. No separately supplied root, name, strict interior time or transversality certificate appears. This passed in the same independent kernel run that checked all 12 new declarations and printed the transparent scaledToWallGerm definition.
